liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Playin' In The Band** (4 reviews): Playin' runs past 25 minutes and is among the show's top performances; Reviewer believes Dick's Picks 31 opens with this night's Playin', and calls that track worth the purchase alone [7][8][14][16]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer enjoys Bertha as the show opener [12]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The reviewer rates Scarlet Begonias as a top-notch performance [7]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Peggy-O is praised for an aching, minimalist feel [11]
- **El Paso** (1 review): Jerry's noodling during El Paso is singled out [11]
- **Weather Report Suite Prelude** (1 review): Bobby slightly fumbles the intro of the Weather Report Suite [17]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Keith responds closely to Jerry in the Let It Grow jam, with a ten-minute meltdown and several grooves leading into Wharf Rat [7]
- **US Blues** (1 review): US Blues is singled out as great, with the end of the second set loved [15]

## The recordings

- **gd74-08-04.aud-moore.weiner.20369.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 233 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [1]
- **gd1974-08-04.sbd.unknown.1631.shnf**: soundboard; 26 songs; 208 min [3]. Said about its sound: Uploader notes problems with Jerry's guitar on the first two tracks listed [3]
- **gd1974-08-04.aud.moore.weiner.gdADT.9112.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 25 songs; 206 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this audience recording really good; Of two audience recordings, this one is judged clearest and sharpest; the other sounds muffled [12][18]
- **gd1974-08-04.mtx.seamons.100653.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 231 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [5]

## Around the show

- Attendee says the Wall of Sound PA took roughly half the first set to dial in; vocals cleared by the fourth or fifth song [9]
- Attendee describes the PA as the most intricate any band had used, filling the hall unlike anything heard before [9]
- Reviewer says the following night had a more interesting Scarlet and a hard-driving Around, though this show still pleased overall [11]
- Reviewer rates this Playin' as very good but not the best of 1974 [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-08-04.aud-moore.weiner.20369.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Mark Cohen and Noah Weiner; source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Jerry Moore taped with two AKG D-1000E mics into a Sony 152 deck, on Maxell cassettes with Dolby B; Mark Cohen transferred the analog tapes to DAT; Noah Weiner then made the SHN/CD [1]
- **gd1974-08-04.sbd.unknown.1631.shnf**: transferred by Unknown; source: SBD>MR>DAT>CDR [3]
- **gd1974-08-04.aud.moore.weiner.gdADT.9112.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Noah Weiner; source: AudMC > DAT > WAV > SHN and AudMC > R? > Beta Hi-Fi PCM > CASS > WAV > CD > EAC > SHN [4]. Also: Second-set lineage may include no reel generation at all; this could not be confirmed; An alternate audience source was used to patch missing tracks and cuts; the taper is assumed to be Jerry Moore [4]
- **gd1974-08-04.mtx.seamons.100653.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [5]. Also: Jerry Moore recorded with two AKG D-1000E mics and a Sony 152 deck; Mark Cohen made the DAT transfer; Taper sat in the front row of the balcony, audience right, about halfway back from the stage; Mics sat in a V on a six-foot extended pole, aimed at the proscenium wings; Bob Fishman supplied the source disk [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead RARE Philadelphia 1974 Concert Poster | #33405429](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-rare-philadelphia-1974-concert) [20]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [Grateful Dead Poster 1974-08-04 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/grateful-dead-poster-1974-08-04-04/) [21]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1974-08-04 Sun Civic Convention Hall Auditorium, Philadelphia, PA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1398747154146/grateful-dead-1974-08-04-sun-civic) [22]
